title: R_F2(P_6) = 16 or 17
statement: Bilinear complexity of 6-term binary polynomial multiplication (GHASH, Classic McEliece). Wang 2026 lower bound 16; Montgomery 2005 upper bound 17. ~7k vars; symmetry, not size, is the wall. Effort estimate: weeks.
